request.query: Weighted order of a power series multiplied by a nonzero constant is unchanged

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.C_mul
MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_smul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {a : R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (a • f)
